name: Mnesos
description: A bookish soldier who carries Perisophia's Essays on Logic and fights with a sling; he is trampled by the minotaurs.

description_citations.text: "The Walls of Akros" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: A wounded cyclops attacks the squad; Pallas is backhanded, and the squad kills it with Mnesos's sling and Nikasios's spear.
timeline.quote: There was a crack as Mnesos's stone met the cyclops's skull, and the creature roared.

citation.text: "The Walls of Akros" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: At night Leandros asks Mnesos why the gods have abandoned them and whether they will return; Mnesos says the gods have retreated into Nyx before.
timeline.quote: The historians tell us that this is not the first time the gods have retreated into Nyx

citation.text: "The Walls of Akros" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Mnesos is gutted by a minotaur and is lost behind the horde; Leandros finds his trampled body later.
timeline.quote: Mnesos fell to the ground, moaning, blood seeping from his stomach.

citation.text: "The Walls of Akros" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Feb 2014.
